evidence.Cards:
{{Thumbnail
|image1=<gallery>
Poppy With Cards.png
</gallery>}}'''Cards''' are a mechanic in [[Dandy's World]]. They can give permanent buffs, [[Items]], or {{Heart}}s. They occur on every odd-numbered [[Floor]]. Players vote on which Cards get played, with the majority vote being the Card selected. If a tie occurs, a Card will be chosen randomly. 3 random Cards out of the 21 options will have a chance to appear until all are eventually voted for. Cards can only be used once until players cycle through the 21 options. Once all Card options have been used (which occurs at Floor 45 {{Small|(Floor 47 in [[Events]])}}), the prompt to vote will stop appearing and the [[Elevator]] will simply move onto the next Floor.

evidence.Dyle's Floor:
{{Stub}}{{MissingInformation|*Layout of Dyle's Floor}}
'''Dyle's Floor''' is the first and only Challenge [[Floor]], and to enter it, the player(s) must choose the {{CDI|TIME'S UP|name=true}} [[Card]] during a Card vote, which is only available on odd Floors. The player(s) must be on Floor 9+ for a chance to get the Card. It also has only one variant. When on this map, the player(s) must complete a total of 25 [[Machines]], regardless of what Floor they're on. The Floor will also spawn 3+ {{Type|Common}} [[Twisteds]], with [[Floor Events]] also being able to happen, along with {{CI|Twisted Dyle|name=true}}. The reward when completing this Floor is +50 Stamina capacity for the rest of the run.
evidence.Floors: A Challenge Floor called the '[[Dyle's Floor]]' can be spawned if the {{CDI|TIME'S UP|name=true}} Card is picked on any odd-numbered Floor, starting at Floor 9. Completing the Dyle's Floor earns you 50 maximum Stamina for the rest of the run. In the Floor, there are guaranteed 25 [[Machines]] to be completed and 4 [[Twisteds]], 3 {{Type|Common}} Twisteds (though a [[Holiday Twisted]] may replace one Common) and the elusive, difficult and {{Type|Lethal}} {{CI|Twisted Dyle|name=true}}.
